canvas_policy: uniform cool-gray paper background; no large white cards or empty white strip
style: generated icon-and-flow composition with near-black outlines and flat muted fills

semantics.primary: the same agent-written condition is read by runtime validation and evaluation
semantics.runtime: Validator directly sends the accepted action to World state and separately records the accepted decision
semantics.selection: the recorded decision set and the same condition enter the record filter, which feeds the conditional rate
semantics.secondary: an accepted action changes world state, which returns as future context
semantics.retry_boundary: retries are not drawn because the frozen corpus lacks the first report before a retry

checks: all labels are legible at full size and print width
no text or icon overlaps an arrow or node border
the single black action arrow starts at Action and enters Validator
the condition branches only to Validator and Record filter
Validator directly sends accepted action to World state
Recorded decisions has a separate arrow to Record filter
the future-context route stays outside the modules
the uniform gray background avoids excessive white space
